```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(viridis)
```

```{r}
grid <- st_read("data/processed_grid/processed_grid.shp")
grid_df <- tibble(grid) # tibble will run summarize faster!
```

```{r}
names(grid)

grid_df %>%
    #filter(!is.na(wf_uids)) %>%
    summarize(
        na_drtn = sum(is.na(mx_drtn)),
        inf_drtn = sum(mx_drtn == -Inf),
        n=n()
    )

grid_df %>%
    mutate(has_rn = n_rx_fr > 0) %>%
    group_by(has_rn) %>%
    summarize(
        mean_acres = mean(max_crs, na.rm=TRUE),
        median_acres = median(max_crs, na.rm=TRUE),
        mean_dur = mean(mx_drtn, na.rm=TRUE),
        median_dur = median(mx_drtn, na.rm=TRUE),
        n=n()
    )

mean(grid_df$mx_drtn, na.rm=TRUE)

max(grid_df$mx_drtn, na.rm=TRUE)

min(grid_df$mx_drtn, na.rm=TRUE)

grid_df %>%
    filter(mx_drtn < 0)
# i honestly have no idea why the mean duration is showing up as -Inf. that doesn't make any sense to me!
```
